name: harbor
author: Matias Lapolla
description: Workspace numbers per monitor bank with a notch that previews each workspace, plus a bottom dock that groups open windows and moves them between workspaces.

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers of this monitor's bank. Rest the pointer on one to drop the notch: a live preview and the apps on that workspace.

schema.label: Hover delay (ms)
schema.description: How long the pointer rests on a number before the notch drops.

schema.label: Live window captures
schema.description: Off draws app icons in the preview instead of window contents.
